name: Secure University Digital Certificate Management System
description: Design a secure digital-certificate management system for a university that manages certificates used by approved campus applications, servers, and network services. Authorized certificate administrators should be able to review certificate requests, approve certificate issuance, renew certificates, revoke compromised certificates, and track certificate status. The system should restrict certificate administration based on approved roles, monitor certificate validity, detect expired certificates and unauthorized certificate changes, generate security alerts, and maintain audit logs of certificate lifecycle activities and administrator actions. The platform should provide a centralized dashboard, integrate with existing university identity services, support multiple campus locations, and remain secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable.

analysis.title: Secure Certificate Management System
analysis.summary: A university shall implement a secure digital-certificate management system that supports certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, and monitoring with role-based access control and real-time alerting for expired or unauthorized certificates.

assessments.explanation: The system shall manage digital certificates used by approved campus applications, servers, and network services.
Authorized certificate administrators shall be able to review requests, approve issuance, renew certificates, revoke compromised ones, and track status via a centralized dashboard.

The system shall restrict access by approved roles, monitor validity, detect expired or unauthorized changes, generate alerts, and maintain audit logs of all lifecycle activities and administrator actions.
The platform shall provide a centralized dashboard, integrate with existing identity services, support multiple campus locations, and remain secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable.
